metadata.question: Did nighttime light intensity across Puerto Rico decline between September 21, 2016, and September 22, 2016?

data.raw_code: The user asks: "Did nighttime light intensity across Puerto Rico decline between September 21, 2016, and September 22, 2016?" Key considerations: 1. Need daily nighttime light data - use NASA/VNP46A1 (VIIRS Black Marble daily product). 2. Geometry: Puerto Rico - use FAO GAUL dataset for accurate boundary. 3. Data quality: Use QF_DNB band (quality flag) to mask poor quality pixels (keep only QF_DNB == 0 for high quality). 4. Time range: Specific single days (2016-09-21 and 2016-09-22). 5. Comparison: Compare mean radiance values between the two days. 6. Handle cases: No images (C1), no valid pixels after masking (C2), calculation failures (C3). Strategy: - Get Puerto Rico geometry from FAO/GAUL/2015/level0. - For each date, filter NASA/VNP46A1 collection by date and bounds. - Check collection size - if 0 for either date, output C1. - For each image, mask using QF_DNB == 0. - Compute mean radiance and pixel count for masked DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m band. - If pixel count == 0, output C2. - If mean is None/NaN, output C3. - Compare means: if 2016-09-22 mean < 2016-09-21 mean, answer A (Yes), else B (No). Note: Use scale=1000 to avoid timeout. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions // Get Puerto Rico geometry from FAO GAUL dataset const countries = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level0'); const puertoRico = countries.filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Puerto Rico')); const geometry = puertoRico.geometry(); // Define dates (single days) const date1 = '2016-09-21'; const date2 = '2016-09-22'; // 2. Data Acquisition - NASA/VNP46A1 (VIIRS Black Marble daily) const collectionId = 'NASA/VNP46A1'; const band = 'DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m'; const qaBand = 'QF_DNB'; // Function to get and process image for a specific date function getImage(date) { const start = ee.Date(date); const end = start.advance(1, 'day'); const col = ee.ImageCollection(collectionId) .filterDate(start, end) .filterBounds(geometry); return col; } // Get collections for both dates const col1 = getImage(date1); const col2 = getImage(date2); // Check if collections are empty const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log(`2016-09-21 Images: ${size1}, 2016-09-22 Images: ${size2}`); console.log('C1'); return; } // Get first image from each collection const img1 = col1.first(); const img2 = col2.first(); // 3. Processing - Mask poor quality pixels (QF_DNB == 0 for high quality) const masked1 = img1.updateMask(img1.select(qaBand).eq(0)); const masked2 = img2.updateMask(img2.select(qaBand).eq(0)); // Function to compute mean and count function computeStats(image) { const reduced = image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: geometry, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); return reduced; } const stats1 = computeStats(masked1.select(band)); const stats2 = computeStats(masked2.select(band)); const mean1 = stats1.get('mean'); const count1 = stats1.get('count'); const mean2 = stats2.get('mean'); const count2 = stats2.get('count'); // Get values (synchronously) const mean1Val = mean1.getInfo(); const count1Val = count1.getInfo(); const mean2Val = mean2.getInfo(); const count2Val = count2.getInfo(); // Check for no valid pixels if (count1Val === 0 || count2Val === 0) { console.log(`2016-09-21 Valid Pixels: ${count1Val}, 2016-09-22 Valid Pixels: ${count2Val}`); console.log('C2'); return; } // Check for calculation failures if (mean1Val === null || mean2Val === null || isNaN(mean1Val) || isNaN(mean2Val)) { console.log(`2016-09-21 Mean: ${mean1Val}, 2016-09-22 Mean: ${mean2Val}`); console.log('C3'); return; } // 4. Output stats and determine answer console.log(`2016-09-21 Mean Radiance: ${mean1Val.toFixed(4)}, Valid Pixels: ${count1Val}`); console.log(`2016-09-22 Mean Radiance: ${mean2Val.toFixed(4)}, Valid Pixels: ${count2Val}`); // 5. Final comparison if (mean2Val < mean1Val) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
